changelog:
Initial release of website-analytics (GA4 for AI agents):

- Provides read-only Google Analytics 4 (GA4) website stats via fleets CLI.
- Supports commands for traffic, campaigns, referrals, landing pages, events, funnels, and more, all sluggified per site.
- Outputs agent-friendly JSON, optional CSV/JSON export, and works in CLI or MCP server mode.
- Setup is fast: single login adds all sites and auto-links GA4 + Search Console.
- Fully read-only and safe; supports multiple sites from a single interface.
summary: Google Analytics (GA4) for AI agents — traffic stats, sources, campaigns, referrals, landing pages, events, and conversion funnels across all your websites from one CLI. Web analytics without the dashboard.
